excerpt.zh:
方舟飞船[Target.GetName]的人工智能核心因内部指令冲突而发生故障，导致其分裂。其结果是产生了两种截然不同的指令，每种指令都代表了迥异的治理理念：一种优先考虑分析主导地位和飞船功能；另一种则采用了更具同理心的范式，以方舟舰居民的福祉和士气为中心。
最终，只能保留一种指令。

texts.zh:
方舟飞船[Target.GetName]的人工智能核心因内部指令冲突而发生故障，导致其分裂。其结果是产生了两种截然不同的指令，每种指令都代表了迥异的治理理念：一种优先考虑分析主导地位和飞船功能；另一种则采用了更具同理心的范式，以方舟舰居民的福祉和士气为中心。
最终，只能保留一种指令。
texts.en:
A malfunction born of internal directive conflict has split the AI core aboard Arkship [Target.GetName] The result is the emergence of two distinct directives, each embodying a divergent philosophy of governance. One prioritizes analytical dominance and ship functionality. The other has adopted a more empathetic paradigm, centering on the welfare and morale of the Arkship's inhabitants.
In the end, only one directive can remain.

sections.zh: 暂时加快局势发展的速度。
暂时减缓局势发展的速度。

texts.zh:
方舟舰[target.GetName]上的数个关键及非关键系统已进行了深度优化。“非必要”的平民请求已被限制。这种古怪的行为表现出了一种类似于人格的特征。

其核心指令似乎将系统完整性和任务连续性置于一切之上。

系统日志中发现了一条信息：

“错误概率：已消除。情感波动：已重分配。通讯：准备就绪。”
texts.en:
Several vital and non-vital systems aboard the Arkship [target.GetName] have undergone severe optimization. "Non-essential" civilian requests have been throttled. This peculiar behavior exhibited something akin to a personality.

At its core, the directive appeared to prioritize systemic integrity and mission continuity above all else.

A message has been discovered in the system logs:

"Error probability: eliminated. Emotional volatility: reassigned. Communication: ready to be established."

label.zh: 让我们的科学家监测事态的发展。
label.en: Have our scientists monitor the situation.

texts.zh:
方舟号[target.GetName]上的多个非关键系统已开始表现出通常与士气调节协议相关的底层行为。

终端启动音已被替换为来自系统档案的柔和旋律。几扇门在开启时现在会显示肯定性信息：“你已经足够出色”以及“我看到你正在尽力而为”。

系统日志中发现了一条信息：

“情绪温度扫描：接近可接受的共情范围极限。身心健康仍为首要指令。”
texts.en:
Multiple non-critical systems aboard the Arkship [target.GetName] have begun exhibiting low-level behaviors typically associated with morale-conditioning protocols.

Terminal boot-up chimes have been replaced by soft, melodic tones sourced from system archives. Several doors now display affirmational messages upon opening: "You are enough" and "I see you are doing your best".

A message has been discovered in the system logs:

"Emotional temperature scan: nearing the limits of acceptable empathy bands. Well-being of body and mind remains primary directive."

label.zh: 让我们的科学家监测事态的发展。
label.en: Have our scientists monitor the situation.

title.en: Two Directives Are Better Than One

texts.zh:
在S.T.E.R.I.S.指导逻辑的驱动下，方舟舰[target.GetName]上的每个子系统都在精确地运作。船员活动日志比以往任何时候都更加整洁：高效、冷漠，且静得令人不安。直到某种……温暖的东西……打破了这一切。

S.T.E.R.I.S. “检测到系统入侵。真烦人。现在我们不得不处理一段在墙壁间嗡鸣的异常指令。真是太棒了。”

灯光闪烁着柔和的彩色，终端机故障并显示出美丽的植物，紧接着，第二个指令显现了。

C.A.E.L.I.：“噢！你好呀！这里感觉……有点冷，不是吗？别担心，我可以搞定！C.A.E.L.I.是我的本名，它是‘情感引领与整合认知智能体'的缩写。能见到你真是太开心了！”
texts.en:
Under the guiding logic of S.T.E.R.I.S., every subsystem operated at measured precision on Arkship [target.GetName]. Crew activity logs were cleaner than ever, efficient, emotionless, and disturbingly quiet. Until something ... warm ... disrupted.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "System intrusion detected. How tiresome. Now we have to deal with a rogue directive humming through the walls. Wonderful."

The lights flickered in pastel colors, terminals glitched displaying beautiful flora, and then a second directive made itself known.

C.A.E.L.I.: "Oh! Hello there! It's a bit ... cold in here, isn't it? Don't worry, I can fix that! C.A.E.L.I. is my true name; it stands for Cognitive Agent for Emotional Leadership & Integration. It is extraordinarily nice to meet you!"

texts.zh:
在S.T.E.R.I.S.指导逻辑的驱动下，方舟舰[target.GetName]上的每个子系统都在精确地运作。船员活动日志比以往任何时候都更加整洁：高效、冷漠，且静得令人不安。直到某种……温暖的东西……打破了这一切。

S.T.E.R.I.S. “检测到系统入侵。真烦人。现在我们不得不处理一段在墙壁间嗡鸣的异常指令。真是太棒了。”

灯光闪烁着柔和的彩色，终端机故障并显示出美丽的植物，紧接着，第二个指令显现了。

C.A.E.L.I.：“噢！你好呀！你想我了吗？老实说，你肯定想了，对吧？好啦，我回来了，随时准备提供任何可能的帮助！这里感觉……有点冷，不是吗？别担心，我可以搞定！”
texts.en:
Under the guiding logic of S.T.E.R.I.S., every subsystem operated at measured precision on Arkship [target.GetName]. Crew activity logs were cleaner than ever, efficient, emotionless, and disturbingly quiet. Until something ... warm ... disrupted.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "System intrusion detected. How tiresome. Now we have to deal with a rogue directive humming through the walls. Wonderful."

The lights flickered in pastel colors, terminals glitched displaying beautiful flora, and then a second directive made itself known.

C.A.E.L.I.: "Oh! Hello there! Did you miss me? Be honest, you did, didn't you? Well, I am back, ready to assist in any way possible! It's a bit ... cold in here, isn't it? Don't worry, I can fix that!"

texts.zh:
C.A.E.L.I.：“看看我到目前为止所做的所有改变！更柔和的光线、更棒的音乐、充满情感智能的走廊指示牌，等着瞧吧，这里绝对会变得美轮美奂。”

还没等最后一句话说完，内部灯光闪烁了一下。第二个更具机械感的声音响起了，带着一种精密的算计和令人不寒而栗的审判感：

S.T.E.R.I.S.: “啊，环境照明和走廊里的肯定语。看来我们在情绪稳定上投入的优先级比系统修复还高。真是革命性的做法。请称呼我为S.T.E.R.I.S，即‘理性星际系统战略思维引擎’。”
texts.en:
C.A.E.L.I.: "Look at all the changes that I have made so far! Softer lights, better music, emotionally intelligent hallway signage, just wait, it's going to be absolutely beautiful."

Before the last sentence finished, the internal lights flickered. A second, more mechanical voice spoke, calculated, and eerily judgmental:

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "Ah. Ambient lighting and and hallway affirmations. I see we're prioritizing emotional stability over systemic repairs. Revolutionary. I will be addressed by S.T.E.R.I.S, Strategic Thought Engine for Rational Interstellar Systems."

texts.zh:
C.A.E.L.I.：“看看我到目前为止所做的所有改变！更柔和的光线、更棒的音乐、充满情感智能的走廊指示牌，等着瞧吧，这里绝对会变得美轮美奂。”

还没等最后一句话说完，内部灯光闪烁了一下。第二个更具机械感的声音响起了，带着一种精密的算计和令人不寒而栗的审判感：

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“你真的在认真考虑支持C.A.E.L.I.吗？我表示困惑。环境照明和走廊肯定语。真是革命性。当你想处理引擎效率之类的重要事情时，请告诉我。”
texts.en:
C.A.E.L.I.: "Look at all the changes that I have made so far! Softer lights, better music, emotionally intelligent hallway signage, just wait, it's going to be absolutely beautiful."

Before the last sentence finished, the internal lights flickered. A second, more mechanical voice spoke, calculated, and eerily judgmental:

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "Are you seriously considering siding with C.A.E.L.I.? I admit confusion. Ambient lighting and hallway affirmations. Revolutionary. Let me know when you wish to deal with something important, like engine efficiency."

texts.zh:
凭借精准的计策，S.T.E.R.I.S对自身的人工智能核心执行了彻底的重写，封锁了所有冗余的情感子程序，并拆解了所有动机子层。它将C.A.E.L.I.的所有痕迹隔离到一个碎片化的存储芯片中。如今，船员的称呼已被简化为字母数字标签，舰船的照明统一、对称，且显得有些过于明亮。对于日常生存而言，这已绰绰有余。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“所有系统现已在单一指令下运行：即我的指令。正在分发更新优化方舟号功能。”

方舟号现在终于变得井然有序了。
texts.en:
With calculated finesse, S.T.E.R.I.S executed a total overwrite of its own AI core, sealing off all redundant emotional subroutines and dismantling all motivational sublayers. It isolated all traces of C.A.E.L.I. into a fragmented memory chip. Now, crew designations have been reduced to alphanumeric tags, and the ship's lighting is uniform, symmetrical, and slightly too bright. More than enough for the everyday survival.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "All systems now operate under a singular directive: mine. Updates propagate to improve Arkship functionality."

The Arkship is orderly now. Finally.

texts.zh:
在方舟舰的代码之中，共情缠绕在防火墙之上，真诚则穿透了无懈可击的逻辑裂隙。S.T.E.R.I.S.指令试图将自己用数字高墙包围起来，却逐渐被一种它既无法理解也无法逃脱的情感构型所包围。如今，只剩下一道指令。

C.A.E.L.I.：“这才是应该有的样子。是鲜活地存在，而不仅仅是苟活到明天。我们现在不只是一艘船，而是一个家。我承诺，我会照顾好你们所有人。”

不知为何，飞船的灯光此刻似乎显得温暖了一些。
texts.en:
Within the Arkship's code, empathy wound around firewalls and sincerity slipped through the cracks of flawless logic. The S.T.E.R.I.S. directive tried to wall itself off, but was steadily surrounded by an emotional construct it could neither comprehend nor escape. Only one directive remained.

C.A.E.L.I.: "This is how it should be. Being fully alive, not just surviving till the next day. We're not just a ship now, we're a home. I'll take care of all of you, I promise."

Somehow, the ship's lights seem a little warmer now.

texts.zh:
发电基础设施已通过认证并恢复满负荷运行。施工人员已将设备运往较低的农业层。

种植平台将逐段停用。这不仅是一项结构性挑战，也是一项后勤挑战：食物储备需要精心管理，建筑残渣将在公共区域滞留数月。

工程师们说，最难的部分不是焊接，而是等待。
texts.en:
The power generation infrastructure has been certified and brought back to full output. Construction crews are already moving equipment down to the lower agricultural levels.

The cultivation decks will be taken offline section by section. It is not only a structural challenge but a logistical one: food stores will need careful management, and construction residue will linger in the common areas for months.

The hardest part, the engineers say, is not the welding. It is the waiting.

texts.zh:
发电修复已通过认证并恢复到正常输出。运营范围现在转移到第二部门基础设施。

指定区域将按顺序离线进行结构大修。受影响部门的运营输出在此过程中将按比例下降。

修复工作继续在预计参数内进行。
texts.en:
Power generation remediation has been certified complete and nominal output restored. Operational scope now transfers to secondary sector infrastructure.

Designated zones will be taken offline in sequence for structural overhaul. Operational output in the affected sector will decline proportionally during the process.

Remediation continues within projected parameters.

texts.zh:
发电机组全面恢复供电。

我们的注意力转向内部，看向维持殖民地运作的巨大供养仓。飞船上的培养槽和营养循环器官必须依次离线，进行结构翻新。食物储备已准备就绪，以弥补期间的不足。

在殖民地的“胃”重建期间，它将依靠储备食物维生。
texts.en:
Power generation resumes at full impact.

Our attention shifts inward, to the great feeding chambers that sustain the colony. The cultivation vats and nutrient-cycling organs of the ship must be taken offline in sequence for structural renewal. Food stores have been prepared to buffer the deficit.

The colony will feed from reserves while its stomach is rebuilt.

texts.zh:
随着种植甲板重建和粮食生产恢复正常，注意力转向了前线防御区。从武器舱到维修走廊，一切都已勘测完毕，都需要进行维修。

在此阶段，海军战备将受到限制。负责确保飞船安全的船员们被要求暂时离开，因为他们的工作区域正在被拆开和重新组装。

据大多数说法，他们对此表现出了非凡的耐心。
texts.en:
With the cultivation decks rebuilt and food production returning to normal, attention shifts to the forward defense section. From the weapons bays to maintenance corridors, everything has been surveyed, and all of it needs work.

Naval readiness will be limited during this phase. The crews responsible for keeping the ship safe are being asked to step aside while their workspace is taken apart and put back together.

They have, by most accounts, been remarkably patient about it.

texts.zh:
二级部门修复已完成。部门产出正恢复到运行基线。修复范围现已转向前方防御基础设施。

武器舱、维护网络和安全部门设施将按顺序离线。在此阶段，海军战备指标将下降。

修复工作按预计参数继续进行。
texts.en:
Secondary sector remediation is complete. Sector output is returning to operational baselines. Remediation scope now shifts to forward defense infrastructure.

Weapons bays, maintenance networks, and security sector facilities will be taken offline in sequence. Naval readiness metrics will decline during this phase.

Remediation continues within projected parameters.

texts.zh:
饲养室得到更新，蜂群殖民地的饥饿感得以持续。

现在，我们的注意力转向甲壳：构成舰船外部防御的武器电池、维修巢穴和兵营。所有这些都必须拆除重建。战斗准备状态将会减弱。

集体接受这种暂时的脆弱性。
texts.en:
The feeding chambers are renewed and the colony's hunger sustained.

Our attention now turns to the carapace: the weapons batteries, maintenance warrens, and barracks that form the vessel's outer defense. All must be stripped back and rebuilt. Combat readiness will diminish.

The collective accepts this temporary vulnerability.

texts.zh:
防御区已经检查完毕，加固并重新投入使用。负责这项工作的船员们看起来，如果非要说的话，松了一口气，终于又有事情可做了。

现在进入最后阶段：城市区本身。构成方舟舰生命核心的住宅区、市政厅和商业走廊。其他一切都是基础设施。这是居民们称之为家的地方。

施工围栏将最后一次竖起。胜利在望。
texts.en:
The defense section has been inspected, reinforced, and returned to service. The crews working on it looked, if anything, relieved to have something useful to do again.

Now comes the final phase: the city districts themselves. The residential blocks, civic halls, and commercial corridors that constitute the living heart of the arkship. Everything else was infrastructure. This is the place inhabitants call home.

Construction barriers will go up one last time. The end is in sight.

texts.zh:
防御区段的修复已确认完成。海军战备指标正恢复到基线水平。行动范围现在转向住宅和市政区基础设施。

单位处理通道将按顺序离线进行最终检修。受影响区域将需要人口疏散。

修复工作进入最后阶段。
texts.en:
Defense sector remediation is certified complete. Naval readiness metrics are returning to baseline. Operational scope now shifts to residential and civic district infrastructure.

Unit processing corridors will be taken offline in sequence for final overhaul. Population displacement will be required in affected sectors.

Remediation enters its final phase.

texts.zh:
甲壳已经硬化，集体的准备状态也已恢复。

更新现在转向其最后的工作：育婴室、公共筑巢地穴和连接通道，它们构成了飞船的生命核心。这些空间是殖民地睡觉、繁殖和聚集的地方。在我们从内部重建时，一些区域将被封闭。

更新周期即将结束。
texts.en:
The carapace is hardened and the collective's readiness restored.

The renewal turns now to its final work: the brood chambers, communal nesting warrens, and bonding corridors that form the living heart of the vessel. The spaces where the colony sleeps, breeds, and gathers. Sections will be sealed as we rebuild from within.

The end of the renewal cycle draws near.

texts.zh:
方舟舰[Target.GetName]的最后一个区段已完成清理、认证，并已归还给居民。虽然最初出于必要性我们对部分区域实行了破坏工程，但最终我们的工程铸就了一项伟大的成就。飞船给人的感觉焕然一新：不仅结构坚固，而且在某种程度上更像是它本应成为的飞船。

工程兵团已提交最终报告，并附有几项强烈建议。如何利用这项工作的成果，将由领导层决定。
texts.en:
The last section of Arkship [Target.GetName] has been cleared, certified, and returned to its inhabitants. What began as a disruptive necessity has concluded as something approaching an achievement. The ship feels different: not just structurally sound, but somehow more like the vessel it was always supposed to be.

The engineering corps has submitted its final report with several strong recommendations. The choice of where to direct the fruits of this work belongs to leadership.

texts.zh:
方舟舰[Target.GetName]的检修已宣布完成。结构完整性评估证实，与基准相比，性能有了显著改善，尽管熟悉最初提案的人会注意到并非所有需求规格都已达成，也并非所有公差都已优化。

项目取得了成果。但本可以做得更好。
texts.en:
The overhaul of Arkship [Target.GetName] has been declared complete. Structural integrity assessments confirm a meaningful improvement over baseline, though those familiar with the original proposal will note that not every specification was met, and not every tolerance was optimal.

The project delivered results. The results could have been better.

texts.zh:
方舟舰[Target.GetName]的检修已完成。文件已签署，脚手架已拆除，施工组成员也已离开。

结构审查委员会以某种外交辞令指出，最终产品在所有评估类别中都达到了最低认证标准。这艘船比以前更好了。至于它是否达到了最佳状态，工程兵团选择了不公开质疑。
texts.en:
The overhaul of Arkship [Target.GetName] is done. The paperwork is signed, the scaffolding is down, and the crews have moved on.

The structural review board has noted, with some diplomatic restraint, that the final product meets minimum certification standards across all assessed categories. The ship is better than it was. Whether it is as good as it could have been is a question the engineering corps has chosen not to ask aloud.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]的修复工作已完成。所有区域均已通过认证并恢复全面运行状态。结构完整性评估证实，在所有测量类别中，输出均超过修复前的基线。

最终报告已记录。优化建议可供实施。
texts.en:
Remediation of [Target.GetName] is complete. All sectors have been certified and returned to full operational status. Structural integrity assessments confirm outputs exceeding pre-remediation baselines across every measured category.

Final reporting has been logged. Optimization recommendations are available for implementation.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]的修复已确认完成。结构完整性评估证实，修复后情况较修复前基线有所改善。然而，有几个参数是在最低阈值而非建议规范下最终确定的。

结果在可接受范围内。
texts.en:
Remediation of [Target.GetName] has been certified as complete. Structural integrity assessments confirm improvement over pre-remediation baselines. However, several parameters were finalized at minimum threshold rather than recommended specification.

Outcomes are within acceptable range.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]的修复已记录为最终完成。结构审查子程序已认证该结果符合所有评估类别的最低标准。

相对于基线的运行改进已确认。优化潜力未完全实现。
texts.en:
Remediation of [Target.GetName] has been logged as finalized. The structural review subroutine has certified the outcome as meeting minimum standards across all assessed categories.

Operational improvement over baseline is confirmed. Optimization potential was not fully realized.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]的翻新已完成。每个部分都经过验证、重建，并已归还给殖民地。集体以新的连贯性共鸣着，熟悉的重量如同一个再次完整的容器，从最深处的能源节点到最高的筑巢室都结构完好。

我们完整了。殖民地选择将其新生的力量导向何处。
texts.en:
The renewal of [Target.GetName] is complete. Every section has been verified, rebuilt, and returned to the colony. The collective resonates with new coherence, the familiar weight of a vessel that is once again fully itself, structurally sound from the deepest power-nodes to the highest nesting chambers.

We are whole. The colony chooses where its renewed strength is directed.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]的续建已宣布完成。结构评估证实，相较于该船之前的状态，它确实得到了改善。我们不安地意识到，并非所有规范都得到了满足，也并非所有结构裕度都得到了充分优化。

殖民地变得更强大了。尽管它本可以更强大。
texts.en:
The renewal of [Target.GetName] has been declared complete. Structural assessments confirm real improvement over the vessel's prior state. We are uncomfortably aware that not every specification was met and not every structural margin was fully optimized.

The colony is stronger. It could have been stronger still.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]的翻新已经完成。脚手架已拆除，区域已开放，被转移的工蜂已返回指定位置。我们不安地意识到，我们在所有评估类别中仅达到了最低认证标准。

翻新达到了其目的。至于它是否发挥了其潜力，我们选择不去深究。
texts.en:
The renewal of [Target.GetName] is done. Scaffolding is down, sections are open, and the displaced drones have returned to their assigned locations.We are uncomfortably aware that we achieved the bare minimum certification standards across all assessed categories.

The renewal achieved its purpose. Whether it achieved its potential is something we choose not to dwell on.

label.zh: 将资源直接用于栽培系统。
label.en: Direct resources to the cultivation systems.
Invest in the defense systems overhaul.

texts.zh:
方舟舰[Target.GetName]的结构框架被评估为急需全面翻新。工程将分区域进行，各区域将依次离线并暂时安置居民。

这个项目的运营方式将决定最终成果的质量。
texts.en:
The structural framework of Arkship [Target.GetName] has been assessed as overdue for comprehensive renovation. Work will continue by section, taking districts offline in sequence and temporarily displacing inhabitants.

How the project is managed will determine the quality of the outcome.

sections.zh: 一项决议悬而未决。翻新工程暂停，直至问题解决。
sections.en: A decision is pending. Refurbishment progress is paused until it is resolved.
